description: Find a person's work email from `first_name`, `last_name` and company `domain`. The common patterns are checked in order against the mail server, most common first. Returns `status` (found, catch_all, unknown, not_found), `email`, `pattern`, `score`, `recommendation` and the addresses `checked`. Costs $0.009 only when an address is found; on a catch-all domain it returns the most likely address as `best_guess`, free.

domain.description: The company's email domain, such as example.com.

name: email_find
title: Find Email Address
